title: Rex and the Pipes Under the Pad
synopsis: The friends observe Star Harbor water suppression testing. Rex connects its pipes to the small Brook Road drains he already knows.
continuity_state: Before: Access road, launch structure and assembly building are present; pad support pipes and water-deluge systems still need testing. After: The pad water-system test succeeds; ground teams continue checking drains, electrical power, cooling, and communication lines.
